card.title: N1K-J SHIDEN
card.flavorText: The Kawanishi N1K-J Shiden (Violet Lightning) was an Imperial Japanese Navy Air Service WWII fighter, a land-based version of the N1K Kyōfū which was a Navy float plane. The Allied nicknamed the aircraft "George" and both pilots and opponents considered it to be one of the finest land-based fighters flown by the Japanese during WWII. The N1K-J Shiden entered service in early 1944 and 1,007 aircraft were produced before production was switched to the improved N1K2-J.
